name: Social Commerce Partners Corporation
summary: Social Commerce Partners Corp. functions as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed with the explicit aim of executing a business combination. Its primary objective involves undertaking various corporate transactions, such as mergers, amalgamations, share exchanges, asset acquisitions, share purchases, or reorganizations, with one or more target businesses. This entity was established on August 11, 2025, and operates from its headquarters located in Plano, Texas.
